formatVersion.description: Version of the word import format.

description.description: Optional Japanese definition-style clue for recall: clear meaning, natural contexts, register or formality, tone, common pairings, and contrast with similar words, phrased without naming the target word.

allOf.description: Optional explanation shown after the answer, such as a useful collocation, register note, or nuance.

Japanese example sentence containing exactly one {{word}} marker where the canonical word should be inserted. The word must fit without conjugation. Furigana notation: add each reading in square brackets immediately after the character it belongs to, with no spaces, for example 資[し]金[きん]. Do not group readings after a multi-character word. For kana-only words, write the word as-is.
Natural English phrase corresponding specifically to the missing Japanese word. It is inserted into the translation template and highlighted during practice.

Natural English translation of the complete Japanese example containing exactly one {{target}} marker where translationTarget should be inserted. Include all surrounding spaces and punctuation in the template.
Alternative contextual prompts rotated during practice. A malformed example rejects this word while other valid words remain importable.

Japanese word or expression to import. Furigana notation: add each reading in square brackets immediately after the character it belongs to, with no spaces, for example 資[し]金[きん]. Do not group readings after a multi-character word. For kana-only words, write the word as-is.

Plain translations for this Japanese word, separated by semicolons and a single space, with no semicolon at the end. Example: qualifications; requirements; capabilities. Do not include explanations, sentences, numbering, or extra notes.
Words to import into the word library.
